title: Executive & Corporate Mobility
subtitle: Private, punctual, and discreet ground transport engineered around the modern executive schedule.
desc: Bespoke chauffeur-driven transport for executives, VIPs, and discerning travellers across the GCC.

features.title: Dedicated Executives
features.desc: Trained, vetted chauffeurs and brand-directed fleets that reflect your company's professional image at every meeting.

features.title: On-Time, Every Time
features.desc: Transport control rooms sync with your calendar and live traffic, guaranteeing arrival at every commitment.

features.title: Single-Point Liaison
features.desc: A dedicated account manager coordinates every journey, itinerary change, and invoice on your behalf.

cardsDesc: From daily executive transport to multi-city roadshows, we design the right mobilisation for your business.

cards.title: Multi-City Roadshows
cards.desc: Seamless inter-city and cross-border transfers for investor meetings, board tours, and stakeholder visits.

cards.title: Executive Hourly Hire
cards.desc: As-directed availability with an executive fleet on standby throughout the business day.

cards.title: Corporate Travel Accounts
cards.desc: Streamlined billing, consolidated reporting, and priority booking for your organisation.

sections.title: Business Travel, Reimagined
paragraphs: Travel should never be a distraction from the work that matters. AB provides executive transport that disappears into your day: a professional chauffeur, a pristine vehicle, and quiet, uninterrupted productivity from door to door.
Whether it is a single board meeting or a week-long itinerary across Riyadh, Dubai, and Doha, your schedule is orchestrated around you-not the other way around.

bullets.text: Productivity features including Wi-Fi and charging on selected vehicles
Quiet, discreet service suited to sensitive business conversations
Flexible scheduling aligned with meeting times and last-minute changes

sections.title: A Fleet That Represents Your Brand
paragraphs: Your transport is part of your corporate image. Our executive fleet of professional-grade sedans and luxury SUVs presents a consistent, polished identity for every client-facing interaction.
Chauffeurs are trained in corporate etiquette, confidentiality, and protocol handling, ensuring your executives are in the most capable hands.

bullets.text: Premium executive sedans and luxury SUVs
Vehicle cleanliness and presentation inspected before every journey

faqs.q: Can AB manage a multi-city corporate roadshow?
faqs.a: Yes. Our transport control room coordinates vehicle, chauffeur, and timing requirements across cities and borders, presenting a single itinerary and consolidated invoice.

faqs.q: Do you offer corporate billing and reporting?
faqs.a: We provide dedicated corporate accounts with monthly consolidated invoices and usage reports to simplify expense management and auditing.

faqs.q: Are executives assigned the same chauffeur?
faqs.a: Where preferred, we allocate a dedicated chauffeur who becomes familiar with your preferences, routes, and schedules for a consistent experience.

ctaDesc: Speak with a corporate mobility specialist about dedicated executive transport, roadshows, and board travel.
